 Hi Michael,

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We hope you are doing well, as spring slowly approaches.

 

 For Lasclay, in the last four years, the month of March marks the start of our National Milkweed Planting Campaign across North America. 

 

 This magnificent plant, grown commercially for its insulating silk we make our outdoor gear with (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KKP6631930FDS8S6Y8QKQRXH_0) , is also an environmental cornerstone that has been bringing serious benefits to our ecosystems for millions of years:

 

 Milkweed is the exclusive host plant of the iconic monarch butterfly, which is threatened with extinction precisely because of the scarcity of milkweed in North America.

 

 The start of large-scale milkweed farming in 2013 has compounded these environmental benefits, but it’s still far from sufficient to ensure the survival of the monarchs, which our company has made its main mission. 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Monarchs need more milkweed, and they need it everywhere. In the countryside, in the suburbs, in the cities. 

 The idea of a nationwide planting campaign was born when we saw the huge amounts of seeds from the milkweed silk extraction process, which until then had been unused.

 With the more than 10 million seeds we redistributed since 2021, tens of thousands of milkweed gardens have been planted since 2021 across the country: a good start for monarchs, for whom Northern USA is the final migratory destination each spring.

 And this year, we have great news to make things even easier for anyone who wants to contribute to the movement. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We are very proud to launch our 2026 National Milkweed Planting Campaign by introducing a new product: 

 Ready-to-plant, cold-stratified milkweed seeds sold in packets (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KKP6631930FDS8S6Y8QKQRXH_1), to replace and simplify our popular seed bombs (they were effective but presenting a significant logistical challenge).

 It has never been easier to start a milkweed garden for monarchs and pollinators. To join the movement, it starts right here: 👇 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get milkweed seeds, start a pollinator garden, help monarch butterflies (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KKP6631930FDS8S6Y8QKQRXH_2)
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 A big thank you, and happy gardening!

 Warmly,

 Gabriel 
Co-founder
Lasclay 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lasclay inc.

 Hello Michael, 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Hope you're doing well on this Saturday morning.

 Well, the monarch Spring migration has officially begun! There have been sightings all over Southern USA (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNCA693Y1Z2YMZY8SPBA3367_0): in Texas, California, Georgia and South Carolina. 

 They will fly and fly further North in the next few months until they reach our milkweed plantations around mid-May, where they will breed happily all summer long until they migrate again and we can harvest the precious milkweed silk to make insulated products (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNCA693Y1Z2YMZY8SPBA3367_1) 🦋♥️

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our National Milkweed Planting Campaign is going pretty well too. Thousands of people have already ordered their milkweed seeds to start their monarch butterfly garden.

 
 To encourage even more people to do so, we are pleased to offer discounts of 40 to 50% on milkweed seeds for a few days only. Hurry, it won't last long! 👇 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Buy milkweed seeds, start a butterfly garden (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNCA693Y1Z2YMZY8SPBA3367_2)

messages.text:
Hello Michael,
 

 We are truly sorry to hear that the germination of your milkweed seeds did not meet your expectations.
 

 Milkweed is especially close to our hearts, it plays a vital role in biodiversity, and we truly care about seeing it thrive in each of our customers’ gardens. 
 

 With this in mind, we will arrange a replacement for your order. We sincerely hope this new attempt will allow you to fully enjoy the beauty and benefits of milkweed.
 

 Please don’t hesitate to keep us updated, it would be a real pleasure to hear how it goes.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
